notes.title: Path to Memento Mori is Going Free-to-Play!
notes.notes:
We created Path to Memento Mori as a passion project. It was never about the money for us; we simply wanted to prove that we could bring our vision to life.

As a small team of two, we designed, developed, and released this game within just a few months—all while juggling full-time jobs. We’re incredibly proud of what we accomplished and the final experience we crafted. Now, we want to share it with as many people as possible, which is why we’ve decided to go free-to-play.

We’ve already applied for the game to transition to a free-to-play model, and we anticipate this change will take effect in the coming weeks.

To those who supported us by purchasing the game, we want to say a huge thank you. Your support means the world to us, even though, financially, this game hasn’t broken even. Your encouragement and enthusiasm have driven us to make this choice to broaden our player base.

So, gather yourself and up to three friends, and dive into Path to Memento Mori, now available as a free-to-play horror experience!
